Performs and visualises spatial pathway enrichment analysis

Source: R/pixelPanel_Enrichment.R
PixelPanel_EnrichmentTab.Rd

UI and server logic for spatial pathway enrichment analysis at the pixel level in the SMEW app. Visualizes spatially-resolved pathway enrichment p-values, distributions, and significance across samples.

Usage

PixelPanel_EnrichmentTabUI(
  id,
  bulk.metadata,
  full.metadata,
  pixel.enrichment,
  show = TRUE
)

PixelPanel_EnrichmentTabServer(
  id,
  bulk.metadata,
  full.metadata,
  full.intensity.matrix,
  anno,
  pixel.enrichment
)

Arguments

id

Shiny module id

bulk.metadata

Data frame of bulk sample metadata

full.metadata

Data frame of full sample metadata

pixel.enrichment

List or data structure with pixel-level enrichment results

show

Logical; whether to show the panel (default TRUE, UI only)

full.intensity.matrix

Matrix of intensities (features x samples)

anno

Data frame of peak annotations

Value

UI: A shiny::tabPanel object for the enrichment panel. Server: None; called for side effects in Shiny module.

None; called for side effects in Shiny module

Details

  • Visualize pre-computed spatial pathway enrichment p-values across samples.

  • Show adjusted p-values or -log10(p-values) spatially.

  • Density and bar plots for p-value distributions and proportion of significant pixels.

  • Download handlers for spatial and bar plots.

  • Interactive controls for pathway selection, capping, and significance threshold.
